title: Unbundle CI tooling into runtime-shared modules and streamline release hooks
author: Priya Shah
description: Summary: This PR extracts reusable CI and release logic from ad-hoc scripts distributed across the monorepo and centralizes them into packages/ci-shared. The goal is to reduce duplication across .github/workflows, make tooling easier to test locally, and provide a single point for dependency updates and linting.
commits:
1) extract: move scripts/ci/* -> packages/ci-shared with README and unit tests
2) shim: add cmd/ci-shim (Go) to replace cross-repo bash entrypoints and support local dev mode
3) workflow: update .github/workflows/* to call ci-shim and import action inputs from packages/ci-shared
4) release: consolidate scripts/release/* into packages/ci-shared/release with idempotent guards and dry-run flag
5) docs: add docs/ci.md and migration checklist for Dedicated/Private deployments
files_changed: packages/ci-shared/{README.md, main.go, release.go, lint.go, go.mod}, cmd/ci-shim/main.go, .github/workflows/{ci.yml, presubmit.yml, release.yml}, scripts/release/* (removed), Makefile (targets updated), docs/ci.md, devcontainer.json, docker/ci.Dockerfile
review_comments:
Ethan Cho (review): 'Nice consolidation — please add a dry-run for the release hook and keep the old release path until the next release to avoid surprises.'
Author (Priya): 'Added --dry-run flag and a compatibility shim; preserved old script for one release cycle and documented the migration steps.'
María González (review): 'Go shim lints failing; add gofmt/golangci-lint check to the new module and a CI step.'
Author: 'Added golangci-lint config and fixed the reported issues; added a fast 'lint:ci' target.'
Liam O'Connor (review): 'On-prem installer references; check that packages/ci-shared is accessible from the private installer build.'
Author: 'Added a make target and a small installer note in docs/ci.md to pull the module during build; validated against a local installer image.'
CI notes: initial CI run failed on integration-test-redis (flaky infra); reran job and it passed; full pipeline green on rerun. Final CI status: pass.
release_notes: Centralize CI scripts into packages/ci-shared; introduce cmd/ci-shim (Go) to standardize entrypoints; release hooks become idempotent and support --dry-run; workflows now reference one source of truth for inputs and action versions; trimmed duplicated workflow matrix entries; added migration notes and devcontainer support.
